records.title: Multimodal joint prediction of traffic spatial-temporal data with graph sparse attention mechanism and bidirectional temporal convolutional network
records.reason: 一次本文を確認した。The paper applies graph sparse attention and temporal convolutions to traffic spatiotemporal prediction. Its domain/model is traffic forecasting, not LLM inference or sparse transformer serving.

records.title: Do Vision & Language Decoders use Images and Text equally? How Self-consistent are their Explanations?
records.reason: 一次本文を確認した。The paper studies whether VLM decoders use image/text inputs consistently and evaluates explanation self-consistency. It does not propose quantization or an inference-efficiency mechanism.

records.title: Speech Translation with Speech Foundation Models and Large Language Models: What is There and What is Missing?
records.reason: 一次本文を確認したが、LLM inference efficiencyとの接続、効果の一般性または技術的な新規性が弱く、理由を付してborderlineに残す。This survey maps speech foundation models and LLMs for speech translation, datasets, architectures and open problems. It is useful background but does not propose/test speculative decoding or a serving optimization.
